snippet.title: Buzz-Saw Blood House - Chainsaw Murder House game
snippet.description:
Join my patreon to download: http://patreon.com/puppetcombo

Buzz-Saw Blood House (2017) - A deep web site kidnaps school girls and drops them into the Buzz-saw Blood House. How long can Emily stay alive? 😱

Special thanks to Drake at octobergames.com for the chainsaw maniac animations
Nick Basset for music
And my patrons for funding these video game nasties
